Admin delete silently succeeded under RLS rejection —/api/admin/{courses,templates} DELETE(and coursesPUT) used the cookie-bound getSupabaseServerClient(). When RLS rejected the write, supabase returned { error: null, data: [] }— no error, zero rows affected — and the route returned 200 success. Frontend optimistically removed the row, success toast fired, but the row reappeared on refresh. User-visible symptom: "delete is not possible to the admin" (visible UI + invisible failure). Fix: switch the actual write togetSupabaseAdmin()(service-role) after the existingprofiles.role === 'admin'gate, plus assert non-empty.select('id') to convert silent zero-row writes into 404. Same pattern as 7 other admin routes (cardcom/refund, template-access, export, import, generate-cover, expenses, course-access). 6-case regression test (src/tests/admin-courses-delete-route.test.ts) explicitly guards the silent-success class. Violates the project rule "NO silent failures".

Same silent-success class on /api/admin/write(covered 11 entities) — Generic admin write route had its own silent-zero-row path through the cookie-bound supabase client. Affected blog, sections, tags, testimonials, reviews, clients, expenses, faq, homepage-cards, media-gallery, orbit-tools (every entity going throughadminUpdate(table, …)from the client). Fix: switch the actual write togetSupabaseAdmin()after the admin role gate; for DELETE/UPDATE assertresult.data.length > 0 and return 404 "הרשומה לא נמצאה" otherwise. 9-case regression test (src/tests/admin-write-route.test.ts) covers 401/403/400 + explicit DELETE-zero-rows + UPDATE-zero-rows + 200-success + 500-error + insert-still-passes-with-empty (mutation guard is delete/update only).

Bulk-bar dropdowns opened LEFT in RTL + concurrent-403 on /admin/free-content — Two issues shipped together. (a) BulkActionsBar's <DropdownMenuContent align="end">flips to LEFT side of trigger in RTL (Radix semantics), making menus overflow off the bar; fixed withalign="start"+sideOffset={4}+collisionPadding={16}. (b) /admin/free-contentfired TWO concurrentfetch('/api/admin/courses?list=1')requests inPromise.all; under CF Workers + OpenNext, two parallel admin auth checks could race and one returned 403 ("Error: אין הרשאת מנהל"). Fix: merge into one combined fetch with productModes=[...COURSE,...LIVE].join(',')and partition response client-side byproduct_mode. Strictly safer regardless of root cause; halves admin-auth roundtrips on the page. Includes a 25-scenario e2e/admin-bulk-actions-dropdowns.spec.tscovering 5 pages × 5 dropdowns.

contracts/: JSON Schemas + fixtures for project-index, suggestion, approval-record, handoff, task-queue, run-report, workspace-registry, control-flags
Emit reports/project-index.json from the sweep (plan path/format, assembly.covered)
Read-only reader for assembly-line reports/queue; assembly-line section in the morning report
Workspace-registry awareness: sweep labels assembly_workspace, never flags or touches them
Interface decision record: D1 status writer, D2 inbox promotion, D3 PLAN.md -> MASTER_PLAN.md, D4 contracts location
Control flags + kill switch enforcement: one gate helper every write path calls (flag on, state/KILL absent, phase gate recorded); missing/unreadable = off
Suggestion + approval record formats and CLI (suggest/list/approve/reject/expire), approval bound to content hash, expiry, hash-chained state/approvals.jsonl
Phase-1 stability gate: criteria and recorder for "ran reliably ~2 weeks" (state/phase-gates.json: 14 green heartbeats, 0 failed/incomplete runs, ro_check clean, Noam sign-off)

Phase 2: approved-task writer into the owning plan (flag plan_append): dry-run diff, provenance line with BRN suggestion id and approval id, flock + tail-hash check, post-check that only additions changed, undo
Audit log + undo manifest format (state/audit.jsonl hash-chained; undo <id>) used by every write power

Phase 3a: archive mover (flag archive_move): moves an approved project into _archive/<date>/<name>/ with manifest.json, 30-day undo window, dry run first, never hard delete; refuses on uncommitted/unpushed work, worktrees, assembly workspaces, running processes, TermFleet-open panes
Phase 3b: approved bloat cleanup (flag cleanup): allow-listed targets only (build output, caches), trash with manifest and size check, dry run first

Phase 4: hand approved implementation tasks to assembly-line (flag handoff_assembly_line): handoff-1.0 file into its declared inbox, requires approval scope handoff-implementation, project allow-listed with autonomy >= 2, provenance checked on its side

Safety test suite with replay fixtures: flags off => every write path refuses; kill switch stops; changed text invalidates approval; expired approval refused; dirty/unpushed repo refused; path outside allow-list refused; undo restores exact bytes
"Turn on" procedure: brainiac enable <phase> writes the flag only after gate checks and a typed confirmation, records who/when in the audit log; brainiac disable and KILL documented
